mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort_order, COUNT(d.id) AS dish_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.category_id = c.id AND d.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC

SELECT d.id, d.category_id, c.name AS category_name, d.name, d.price, d.emoji, d.description, d.sales, d.stock, d.status FROM dish d JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id WHERE d.status = 1
AND d.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY d.category_id ASC, d.sales DESC

SELECT d.id, d.category_id, c.name AS category_name, d.name, d.price, d.emoji, d.description, d.sales, d.stock, d.status, d.created_at FROM dish d JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id ORDER BY d.status DESC, d.category_id ASC, d.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (category_id, name, price, emoji, description, sales, stock, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{emoji}, #{description}, 0, #{stock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, price = #{price}, emoji = #{emoji}, description = #{description}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
